chapters.title: Functions
chapters.notes: Domain and range, composite functions fg(x), inverse functions f⁻¹(x), modulus functions |f(x)|.

chapters.title: Quadratic functions
chapters.notes: Completing the square, the discriminant b² − 4ac (two, one or no real roots), the quadratic formula x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a, quadratic inequalities.

chapters.title: Indices and surds
chapters.notes: Laws of indices, simplifying surds like √12 = 2√3, rationalising the denominator.

chapters.title: Logarithms
chapters.notes: log_a(xy) = log_a x + log_a y, change of base, solving aˣ = b with logs, natural log ln and e.

chapters.title: Coordinate geometry
chapters.notes: Gradient m = (y₂ − y₁) ÷ (x₂ − x₁), midpoint, distance between two points, equation of a line y = mx + c, perpendicular gradients multiply to −1.

chapters.title: Trigonometry
chapters.notes: sin, cos, tan of any angle, identities sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 and tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ, radians, arc length s = rθ, sector area ½r²θ.

chapters.title: Differentiation
chapters.notes: d/dx of xⁿ is nxⁿ⁻¹, chain, product and quotient rules, gradients of curves, stationary points, rates of change.

chapters.title: Integration
chapters.notes: Integration as the reverse of differentiation, ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹ ÷ (n + 1) + c, definite integrals and area under a curve.

chapters.title: Motion
chapters.notes: Speed v = d ÷ t, acceleration a = (v − u) ÷ t, distance-time and speed-time graphs, g = 9.8 m/s².

chapters.title: Forces
chapters.notes: Newton's laws, F = m × a, weight W = m × g, friction, moments (moment = force × perpendicular distance).

chapters.title: Energy, work and power
chapters.notes: Work done W = F × d, kinetic energy ½mv², potential energy mgh, power P = W ÷ t, efficiency.

chapters.title: Pressure
chapters.notes: Pressure p = F ÷ A, pressure in liquids p = ρgh.

chapters.title: Electricity
chapters.notes: Ohm's law V = I × R, series and parallel circuits, power P = V × I, charge Q = I × t.

chapters.title: Waves and light
chapters.notes: Wave speed v = f × λ, reflection, refraction, n = sin i ÷ sin r, the electromagnetic spectrum.

chapters.title: Atomic structure
chapters.notes: Protons, neutrons, electrons, atomic number and mass number, isotopes, electron shells 2, 8, 8.

chapters.title: Bonding
chapters.notes: Ionic bonding (NaCl), covalent bonding (H₂O, CO₂), metallic bonding.

chapters.title: Moles and equations
chapters.notes: Balancing equations like 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, the mole, moles = mass ÷ molar mass, concentration in mol/dm³.

chapters.title: Acids, bases and salts
chapters.notes: pH scale, neutralisation acid + base → salt + water, indicators.

chapters.title: Rates of reaction
chapters.notes: Effect of temperature, concentration, surface area and catalysts on rate.

chapters.title: Cells
chapters.notes: Plant and animal cells, organelles (nucleus, mitochondria, chloroplasts), diffusion and osmosis.

chapters.title: Plant nutrition
chapters.notes: Photosynthesis 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ using light and chlorophyll, limiting factors, leaf structure.

chapters.title: Human nutrition
chapters.notes: Balanced diet, enzymes, the digestive system.

chapters.title: Respiration
chapters.notes: Aerobic respiration glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy, anaerobic respiration.

chapters.title: Transport in humans
chapters.notes: The heart, blood vessels, blood.

chapters.title: Data representation
chapters.notes: Binary, denary and hexadecimal, converting between them, bits and bytes.

chapters.title: Algorithms
chapters.notes: Flowcharts, pseudocode, linear and binary search, bubble sort, Big O like O(n) and O(n log n).

chapters.title: Programming
chapters.notes: Variables, selection (IF), iteration (FOR, WHILE), arrays, functions, i++ and i = i + 1.

chapters.title: Logic gates
chapters.notes: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, truth tables.

chapters.title: Networks
chapters.notes: LAN and WAN, IP addresses, packets, protocols like HTTP and TCP.

chapters.title: Reading comprehension
chapters.notes: Finding the main idea, inference, writer's purpose, answering in your own words.

chapters.title: Summary writing
chapters.notes: Picking key points, keeping it short, using your own words, word limits.

chapters.title: Directed writing
chapters.notes: Letters, reports, speeches, matching the audience and purpose.

chapters.title: Narrative and descriptive writing
chapters.notes: Planning, paragraphs, vivid vocabulary, show don't tell.

chapters.title: Grammar
chapters.notes: Tenses, subject-verb agreement, punctuation, active and passive voice.
